data_basis: Complete saved paired exports; round order, values, duration means and accuracy endpoints validated against paired summaries. Available raw logs match their recorded hashes. Missing raw files cannot be rechecked from this checkout.
target_choice: Illustrative thresholds selected for this analysis, not preregistered
higher_targets: Case export retains higher targets with non-reached outcomes and observed horizon durations; no successful crossing imputed
timing_scope: BaitFL logged round timer and no-defense component sum; different timer boundaries and host load; descriptive saved executions, not a controlled speedup benchmark
endpoint: First round with accuracy at or above target; sum recorded round times through that round
averaging: Matched seeds within attack, then all four attacks equally
